title: Subprocess context injection — pick-and-choose session context

Q1.decision: Source-list (composable) — context:['full','memory'] composes; an enum makes sources mutually exclusive.
Q1.question: context as a source-list vs a single enum?
Q1.rec: Source-list (composable) — context:['full','memory'] composes; an enum makes sources mutually exclusive.

Q2.decision: Yes — compact, full, memory, read_paths all ship in v1.
Q2.question: Sources in v1: compact, full, memory, read_paths?
Q2.rec: Yes — compact, full, memory, read_paths all ship in v1.

Q3.decision: full = recent raw turns (capped) + compact of older; no double-count when both full and compact listed.
Q3.question: full = recent raw + compact of older (no double-count)?
Q3.rec: full = recent raw turns (capped) + compact of older; no double-count when both full and compact listed.

Q4.decision: Prepend to prompt (driver-agnostic, one mechanism for grok/claude/opencode); claude --append-system-prompt and context-file are rejected as non-uniform.
Q4.question: Delivery — prepend vs --append-system-prompt vs context file?
Q4.rec: Prepend to prompt (driver-agnostic, one mechanism for grok/claude/opencode); claude --append-system-prompt and context-file are rejected as non-uniform.

Q5.decision: Total cap 16000 chars; per-source caps compact 6000 / full 12000+6000 / memory 4000 / read_paths 1500.
Q5.question: Caps — total 16000, per-source as specced?
Q5.rec: Total cap 16000 chars; per-source caps compact 6000 / full 12000+6000 / memory 4000 / read_paths 1500.

Q6.decision: memory seeded from prompt + recent user turns, top-K = 5.
Q6.question: memory seeding — prompt + recent turns, top-K 5?
Q6.rec: memory seeded from prompt + recent user turns, top-K = 5.

Q7.decision: Yes — TurnContext.ReadPaths already exists; near-free, useful for file-edit handoffs.
Q7.question: Include read_paths?
Q7.rec: Yes — TurnContext.ReadPaths already exists; near-free, useful for file-edit handoffs.

Q8.decision: New tool session_set_subprocess_context (mirrors session_set_model / session_set_agent_preset); echoes effective config; [] or clear reverts.
Q8.question: Per-session override via session_set_subprocess_context?
Q8.rec: New tool session_set_subprocess_context (mirrors session_set_model / session_set_agent_preset); echoes effective config; [] or clear reverts.

Q9.decision: Preset default as agent_presets.context / context_max_chars (schema v9), edited in Settings → Agents (ADR-0030 preset editor).
Q9.question: Preset-level default in Settings → Agents?
Q9.rec: Preset default as agent_presets.context / context_max_chars (schema v9), edited in Settings → Agents (ADR-0030 preset editor).

Q10.decision: Per-call → per-session → preset/global default; max_chars resolves the same way.
Q10.question: Resolution order — call → session → default?
Q10.rec: Per-call → per-session → preset/global default; max_chars resolves the same way.

Q11.decision: Yes — routed turns (ADR-0030) honor the same resolution via TurnOpts context override; one mechanism for both paths.
Q11.question: Routed turns honor the same mechanism?
Q11.rec: Yes — routed turns (ADR-0030) honor the same resolution via TurnOpts context override; one mechanism for both paths.

Q12.notes: Default context is full+memory (not none); operator opts out via per-call [] / session override / preset default. Changes the cost/leakage posture vs the rec (opt-in none).
Q12.question: Default none (opt-in only)?
Q12.rec: Default none (opt-in only) — preserves today's cost/behavior; cheap throwaway runs stay isolated.
